title: Constructible compact support under a target isomorphism
statement: Fix a prime l, an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l, and a finite-field datum D with l different from its characteristic. Let X,Y,Z be finite-type schemes over D.k, with l invertible in all residue fields of Y and Z. Let f:X→Y and g:X→Z be separated finite-type morphisms over D.k, and let e:Y≅Z be a scheme isomorphism with f≫e.hom=g. For arbitrary normalized coefficient exceptional systems S for f and S' for g, and compactifications c and c', their common-stage left operations satisfy F_{S,c} ≅ F_{S',c'} ⋙ e*. The pullback e* is the published commonStageDerivedPullback on the actual common-field constructible category. Neither native Weil complexes, exceptional right images of units, nor realizations occur in the conclusion. Definitions: [lem-sf-constructible-exceptional-adjunction-coefficients], [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], [def-weil-finite-field-fiber].

proof.text: Apply the stagewise compact-support target comparison to obtain a family q of isomorphisms on every common finite coefficient stage, with compatibility for all stage transition isomorphisms.

Apply the directed-stage descent construction to q and its transition compatibility. It assembles the stage isomorphisms into the displayed natural isomorphism of pair-category functors, hence gives the required Nonempty witness.

theorem constructible_compact_support_target_iso
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω]
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{max u v}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{max u v}}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Z.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Z ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Z ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    [∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : X ⟶ Z) (e : Y ≅ Z) (h : f ≫ e.hom = g)
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [g.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [IsSeparated g] [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g]
    (S : System.{u, v} l Ω D hl (f := f)) (c : Compactification f)
    (S' : System.{u, v} l Ω D hl (f := g)) (c' : Compactification g) :
    Nonempty ((S.ring.operation c .closed).F ≅
      (S'.ring.operation c' .closed).F ⋙ commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω e.hom)
